text:
This notice should be read with the Merchant Shipping (Crew Agreements, Lists of Crew and Discharge of Seamen) Regulations 1991 (SI 1991/2144) (the “Crew Agreement Regulations”) and replaces MGN 474 (M) amendment 1.

Notice to

shipowners

ship operators and ship managers

employers of seafarers

masters

officers and seafarers on ships and other sea-going vessels which are not subject to the Maritime Labour Convention 2006 (MLC).
